title: Minimum Deletion Cost to Make All Characters Equal
summary: Given a string and an array of deletion costs, find the minimum cost to delete characters so the remaining string has identical characters.
statement: Given a string and an array of deletion costs, find the minimum cost to delete characters so the remaining string has identical characters.
constraints: s and cost have equal length up to 100,000.
Deleting s[i] costs cost[i], which is positive.
Delete characters until every remaining character is identical, minimizing total cost.
hints: Choosing the final character determines exactly which positions must be deleted.
Compute the total cost and the cost sum belonging to each character.
Keep the character with the largest saved cost and subtract that amount from the total.
Every feasible result keeps one character class, so maximizing saved cost is equivalent to minimizing deleted cost.
editorial: Every feasible result keeps one character class, so maximizing saved cost is equivalent to minimizing deleted cost.

tests.explanation: Keeping c saves cost ten, the largest character total, so deleting all other positions costs eleven.
Keeping b saves cost one hundred, so delete the two a characters for ten.
